purpose: Teach: 引きずっ/報道陣/ピッチャー/鉄則/真っ向/共犯/深まっ/心拍

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、過去の事例を引きずって、診療スタイル、慎重です。
lines.en: Ren, you're carrying past cases with you — your clinical approach is careful, measured.
lines.style: Steady, observational tone. No judgment, just clear sight. The voice of someone who sees this pattern often and speaks it with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最近、報道陣、医療現場、関心高いですね。
lines.en: The press has been paying a lot of attention to medical practice lately, haven't they?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, not rhetorical. Slight hesitation—testing whether this is a safe topic. Soft, inviting him to share what he's noticed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。野球で言うピッチャー、医療チームの主軸的存在、必要です。
lines.en: Yes. In baseball terms, the pitcher is the core of the team. In medicine, it's the same — the doctor is the central force.
lines.style: Patient explanation with a teaching quality. Uses the metaphor to make it clear. Unhurried, giving him time to follow the logic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療の鉄則、患者ファースト、ですね。
lines.en: So the fundamental rule is always patient-first, then?
lines.style: Testing understanding, not challenging. A small, probing question. Respectful pause before he speaks, waiting to see if he's really listening.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者と真っ向から向き合う、それが基本。
lines.en: Yes. Meeting the patient face-on, without pretense or distance — that's the foundation.
lines.style: Firm but not rigid. Each word carries weight. The voice of someone who has built her practice on this one principle and doesn't soften it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症の共犯的要因、生活習慣、深堀りされていますね。
lines.en: I see. So you dig deeper into the lifestyle factors that contribute to infection — the habits underneath the symptoms.
lines.style: Confirming, engaged. He's following her logic and reflecting it back. Slight forward lean in his posture within the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者の悩み、深まった時、寄り添うのが医師の役目。
lines.en: Yes. When a patient's worry deepens, my job is to be present with them — not above them, beside them.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Almost vulnerable in its honesty. No distance between her and the words. Slight weariness underneath—the toll of actual care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 心拍計、最新型、研究室にもありますね。
lines.en: We have one of those heart-rate monitors in the lab too — the latest model.
lines.style: Connecting the dots out loud. A small, genuine observation. Ending with slight lift — inviting her to make the connection he's drawing.
